decision_rule: Approve only the enumerated CPython source-code Git blobs at the exact pinned upstream commit after exact license-blob verification, code-only path enforcement, privacy/secret scan, Python parse validation, current-training-registry deduplication, and evaluation-reservation exclusion. Public availability alone never authorizes training.

license.scope_note: The exact CPython LICENSE states that Python software and documentation are licensed under Python Software Foundation License Version 2 and that some incorporated software may carry different licenses. This admission is therefore restricted to the enumerated first-party Lib/*.py objects and fails closed on file-local alternate-license markers.
license.redistribution_conditions: Retain the PSF License Agreement and PSF copyright notice in Python or derivative versions; if a derivative work incorporating Python is made available to others, include a brief summary of changes. No trademark endorsement permission is granted. Preserve any applicable incorporated historical notices in the exact LICENSE file when redistributing the admitted snapshot bundle.

training_purpose_authority.basis: The reviewed PSF-2.0 grant expressly permits reproduce, analyze, test, prepare derivative works, distribute, and otherwise use Python. Under the project explicit-model-training policy, the enumerated exact source-code objects are approved for pretraining use subject to the license conditions; this decision is not inferred from public accessibility.

explicit_exclusions.evaluation: Any object marked benchmark/held-out/reserved or otherwise present in a current evaluation reservation authority is excluded. This worker grants no evaluation use.

evaluation_boundary.basis: At review cutoff EVAL-233 preserves 16 UA/EN final-test records and reports zero code evaluation records; DATA-227 code is training-only. Repository-wide identity/path searches found none of the enumerated CPython Lib/*.py objects in evaluation authorities.
